title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib versions prior to 3.8.1 and 6.3.1_1 contain a vulnerability in token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body. This causes grant and scope validation to be performed under the attacker-supplied client_id rather than the authenticated client's identity. The issue affects the client_credentials and password grant flows and can lead to unauthorized token issuance with elevated scopes or grants.
